children: and Taiwanese server maker Wiwynn are expanding Wiwynn’s manufacturing operations in Socorro, Texas, as the companies move to increase U.S. production of hardware for data centers.

The expansion will take Wiwynn’s total investment in the Texas facility above $1.6 billion and is expected to create nearly 1,000 advanced manufacturing jobs by the end of 2027, the companies said. Employment at the site is expected to exceed 2,500 next year and reach 4,000 at full capacity.
Wiwynn manufactures and integrates server systems and racks for Amazon’s data-center infrastructure. Amazon
said the expansion will bring production of custom hardware to the United States and strengthen its domestic supply chain.

Wiwynn said the Texas site, its first U.S. manufacturing facility, will hire workers across manufacturing, engineering, testing, automation, maintenance, supply chain and production operations.
